viewer.title: Ilebhu Enzulu
viewer.atlasSubtitle: Phonononga imodeli ephilayo yeenkqubo eziyi-{{count}} zomzimba. Khetha inkqubo, yahlula iinxalenye zayo uze ukhethe isakhiwo ukuze uhlole indima yaso.
viewer.atlasGuidedBy: Ukhokelwa nguGqr. Alistair Vance · Ilebhu yebhayoloji ye-XR, umgangatho 4 ·
viewer.noMatches: Akukho ziphumo. Zama elinye lamagama acetyisiweyo.
viewer.tapHint: Chukumisa inxalenye kwimodeli ukuze uhlole indima yayo. Tsala ukuze ujikeleze ngaphandle kokukhetha.
viewer.webglError: Esi sikhangeli asikwazanga ukuqala umbonisi we-3D. Nika amandla i-WebGL uze ulayishe kwakhona.

pricing.title: Ikhampasi enye, uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali lonke
pricing.subtitle: Qala simahla. Nyukela xa ufuna ukufundiswa kwe-AI okungakumbi, izatifikethi okanye izihlalo. Eyonyaka yonga iinyanga ezimbini.
pricing.trialBody: Izicwangciso ezihlawulwayo ziquka iintsuku eziyi-14 zokuzama (iintsuku ezingama-30 ezikoleni). Rhoxisa nanini na.
pricing.payBody: Amakhadi nge-Stripe (USD) ne-PayFast (ZAR) — kuquka i-Instant EFT, i-SnapScan ne-mobicred apho zifumaneka khona.
pricing.cancelBody: Rhoxisa ekupheleni kwexesha kwiphothali yakho. Ugcina ufikelelo kude kuphele — akukho sivumelwano.

anatomy.label: I-Atlasi Yomntu
anatomy.description: Phonononga iinkqubo zomntu njengemodeli esebenzisanayo. Yahlula izakhiwo ubone indlela ezisebenzisana ngayo.

plants.label: Iinkqubo Zezityalo
plants.description: Landela indlela iingcambu, imithambo yezityalo kunye namagqabi ahambisa ngayo amanzi aze abambe amandla.

engineering.label: Iinkqubo Zeebhulorho
engineering.description: Hlakaza ibhulorho yetrusi ubone indlela amandla ahamba ngayo.

vehicle.label: Iinkqubo Zemoto Yombane
vehicle.description: Hlakaza i-SUV yombane: ukugcinwa kwamandla, iimotori, i-chassis nomzimba.

earth.label: Iinkqubo Zomhlaba
earth.description: Phonononga iplanethi enomaleko neenkqubo ezenza umphezulu wayo nomoya.

middle.focus: Iindlela zokusebenza: isebenza njani, ungayivavanya njani?

high.label: Isikolo samabanga aphezulu
high.focus: Imithetho nobungqina: kutheni kufuneka iziphathe ngolu hlobo, sazi njani?

university.label: Iyunivesithi
university.focus: Jikelele: phantsi kwaziphi iimeko oku kusebenza, kuphi apho kophuka?
